abstract: Cell-cell communication (CCC) analysis has become a cornerstone in dissecting single-cell and spatial omics data, having an indispensable role in high-throughput screening and comprehensive characterization of tissue communication landscapes. Computational models and analytical objectives have emerged continuously in recent years, propelling CCC methodology development and leading to unprecedented biological discoveries. Methodological varieties and differences in their characteristics underscore the urgent need for a coherent framework bridging between CCC biology and computational advances. Here, we systematically curate 161 published CCC methods, classifying them hierarchically into two primary categories and nine subcategories based on their functions and model features and highlighting the power of CCC methods using oncology examples. Four directions for future CCC methodology development are presented, emphasizing AI-biology integration. This Review aims to delineate the CCC algorithm-demand landscape, thereby fostering comprehensive, in-depth and reliable elucidation of CCC and facilitating broad applications in biology and disease studies.
